services.name: Skydive Monroe
services.desc: Welcome experienced sport skydivers! We offer one of the nicest and fastest King Air’s in the industry ready to rocket you to 14,000 feet in under ten minutes. We have a healthy sport jump community near Atlanta, GA with clean facilities and great attitudes. We hope to see you at the DZ soon! Skydive Monroe has a spacious, grassy landing area to accommodate all students and USPA license holders. Skydive Monroe’s fleet of aircraft is meticulously maintained to ensure our jumpers safety and comfort. Our beautiful King Air is one of the industry’s finest jump planes. services.desc: If you know jumping out of a plane is for you and you’ve never done it before, then a first time tandem skydive is a great place to start skydiving Atlanta immediately! Tandem skydiving is our most popular skydiving opportunity that allows guests from 18 to 80 (and in some cases beyond that!) to experience 60 seconds of freefall exiting at an altitude of 14,000 feet. You will share a tandem skydiving harness with one of our professional instructors who will show you why birds fly! At approximately 5,500 feet your instructor will deploy the main parachute allowing you to take in the surrounding views while skydiving Atlanta with approximately five minutes of peaceful flying. blurb: Guests can experience tandem skydiving from 14,000 feet with a certified instructor, including about 60 seconds of freefall and approximately five minutes of canopy flight. The dropzone also offers the Accelerated Freefall (AFF) program, a seven-level course to become a licensed solo skydiver. Experienced skydivers can use the facilities and aircraft for sport jumps.
